description: Rebuild a staging site from the live site (or a backup pair); everything changed on staging is lost. Queued; poll get_wordpress_staging. Confirm with the user first.

db_id.description: Optional: the database backup to go with fs_id.

domain.description: Domain of the Cloud for WordPress site, e.g. `example.com`.

dry_run.description: Validate and preview without changing anything.

fs_id.description: Optional: build from this files backup of the live site (with db_id), from list_wordpress_backups.

name: reset_wordpress_staging
title: Reset Wordpress Staging
